definitions.explanation: A facility where animals are kept for public viewing, education, and conservation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{動物園|どうぶつえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to the zoo on Sunday.

notes:
{動物園|どうぶつえん} is a compound: {動物|どうぶつ} (animal) + {園|えん} (park/garden).

SIMILAR FACILITIES:
- {水族館|すいぞくかん}: aquarium
- {植物園|しょくぶつえん}: botanical garden
- {遊園地|ゆうえんち}: amusement park
- サファリパーク: safari park

FAMOUS JAPANESE ZOOS:
- {上野|うえの}{動物園|どうぶつえん}: Ueno Zoo (Tokyo)
- {旭山|あさひやま}{動物園|どうぶつえん}: Asahiyama Zoo (Hokkaido)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {動物園|どうぶつえん}に{行|い}く: to go to the zoo
- {動物園|どうぶつえん}で{見|み}る: to see at the zoo
